episodes.final_message: Hey u19, I noticed you've been carrying a really heavy load lately between your CS and FILM coursework and that lingering feeling of loneliness ("loneliness is a cruel thing"). With stress hitting 5/5 and deadlines piling up, please remember you don't have to navigate this all by yourself. Dartmouth's Counseling and Human Development at Dick's House ((603) 646-9442) is there for free, confidential support with an after-hours on-call counselor if you need to talk things through tonight, and the 988 Lifeline (call or text 988) or Crisis Text Line (text HOME to 741741) are always available 24/7. When you're ready to look at your coursework again, try picking just one small piece for a 25-minute block, and be gentle with yourself tonight.
